newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper falls against weak world trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper falls against weak world trends.

text.p: Indian copper prices fell on Monday on higher supplies and unloading by stockists on the back of weak trends in the world market, dealers said.
Nickel gained by 100 rupees to 37,200 rupeeson fresh enquiries from the stainless steel industry coupled with thin supply. Ready copper fell by 100 rupees to 12,500 rupees.
Nickel Lead was quiet at the reduced level of 4,450 rupees on eased pressure of arrivals. Lead fell by 150 rupees last week.
Tin was steady at 35,100 rupees, aluminium at 7,300 rupees and zinc at 6,475 rupees on nominal trading.
